title: Geometric points detect maps from étale field schemes
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure, X an etale K-scheme [def-weil-etale-morphism] and Y any scheme. If f,g:X→Y agree after every K-geometric point Spec Ksep→X, then f=g.

source.place: Tag 03QR, full-faithfulness proof, using Morphisms Tag 02GL

proof.text: Quasi-finiteness gives discreteness over the one-point field spectrum. The source is reduced by [etale-proposition-etale-reduced]. Each singleton open is nonempty, reduced and irreducible, hence integral.

Mathlib Scheme.exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed gives a geometric point on each singleton open. It is surjective and flat by the integral one-point target. Flat.epi_of_flat_of_surjective makes it an epimorphism. Cancel it in the assumed equality and apply Scheme.hom_ext_of_forall.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03QR with Tag 02GL; faithfulness via singleton opens and flat epimorphisms

mathlib_searches.query: Geometric points detect morphisms from an etale scheme over a field
Maps of schemes are equal if they agree after composition with all geometric points of an etale scheme over a field
